say:3:1221208001:1.text: I won't let you go until you pay me back!
say:3:1221208001:1.source_cn: 你这个诈骗犯，不赔我的钱，今天你就别想走！

say:4:1221208002:1.text: I... I am not a scammer. Whatever I told you was your real divination!
say:4:1221208002:1.source_cn: 我……我不是诈骗犯，这真的是命运的预兆，是占卜出来的结果！

choice_prompt:5:1221208002.text: I... I am not a scammer. Whatever I told you was your real divination!
choice_prompt:5:1221208002.source_cn: 我……我不是诈骗犯，这真的是命运的预兆，是占卜出来的结果！

say:6:1221208003:1.text: Did you have a divination done by this woman? Don't let her trick you!
say:6:1221208003:1.source_cn: 你们刚才在找她占卜是不是？我告诉你们，别被这个女人骗了！
say:6:1221208003:1.male: Did you have a divination done by this woman? Don't let her trick you!
say:6:1221208003:1.female: Did you have a divination done by this woman? Don't let her trick you!

say:7:1221208005:1.text: Just the other day, she said I was the chosen one and insisted on doing divination for me, saying I was about to make a huge fortune.
say:7:1221208005:1.source_cn: 前些天她说我是什么命定之子，非要给我占卜，说我有大财运。

say:8:1221208006:1.text: Huh? You're the chosen one too?

say:9:1221208007:1.text: Chosen my foot! Soon after the divination, a merchant approached me to discuss an investment opportunity. I was so excited, thinking my fortune had arrived.
say:9:1221208007:1.source_cn: 命定个屁！占卜完没多久，有个商人来跟我谈一笔投资，我当...

say:10:1221208008:1.text: Guess what happened? He was a fraud! He swindled me out of a large sum of money and fled last night!
say:10:1221208008:1.source_cn: 结果那商人是个骗子！他骗了我一大笔钱，昨晚趁夜跑了！

say:11:1221208009:1.text: You must be in cahoots with him! Everything you said was just to fleece me!
say:11:1221208009:1.source_cn: 我看你和那个商人是一伙的！什么占卜，什么财运，你就是为...

say:12:1221208010:1.text: T—That's a baseless accusation! I only said things based on my divination, and I never asked you to make that investment!
say:12:1221208010:1.source_cn: 你……你污蔑我！我说你有财运，只是对占卜结果的解读，但...

say:13:1221208011:1.text: Nonsense! If it weren't for you, I wouldn't have trusted that merchant!
say:13:1221208011:1.source_cn: 胡说！要不是你，我怎么会相信那个商人！

say:14:1221208012:1.text: Actually, even though she's just a mediocre diviner, I don't think you being scammed has anything to do with her...
say:14:1221208012:1.source_cn: 呃，虽然她占卜结果不怎么准，但我觉得你被骗钱和她没什么...

say:15:1221208013:1.text: Why is there a hamster here? Ah, I see it now—you're in on it! That makes you a scammer too!
say:15:1221208013:1.source_cn: 哪来的小老鼠？啊，我知道了，你跟她也是一伙的！你也是诈骗犯！

say:16:1221208014:1.source_cn: 什么……我也是诈骗犯？你太不讲道理了！

say:17:1221208015:1.text: I don't reason with scammers! Let's beat them up until they cough up some coin!
say:17:1221208015:1.source_cn: 跟诈骗犯讲什么道理！给我打，打到他们还钱为止！

say:19:1221208004:1.text: Yes. This woman here calls herself a diviner, but she's actually a scammer!
say:19:1221208004:1.source_cn: 对，就是这个女人，自称什么占卜师，其实是个诈骗犯！
say:19:1221208004:1.male: Yes. This woman here calls herself a diviner, but she's actually a scammer!
say:19:1221208004:1.female: Yes. This woman here calls herself a diviner, but she's actually a scammer!
